findings.evidence: `rg "schwarzReflection"` shows the only prior Schwarz-reflection upper-branch lemma is `TauCeti/Analysis/Complex/Conformal/Reflection.lean:54` `schwarzReflection_of_im_nonneg`; Mathlib provides the generic replacements at `Mathlib/Topology/ContinuousOn.lean:370` `ContinuousOn.congr` and `Mathlib/Analysis/Calculus/FDeriv/Congr.lean:201` `DifferentiableOn.congr`, and the new lemmas at lines 70, 78, and 87 are exactly one-line applications of these.
findings.fix: Remove these wrappers; at use sites write `hf.congr fun z hz => schwarzReflection_of_im_nonneg (f := f) (hS z hz)` for both continuity and differentiability, or the same lambda directly when an `EqOn` proof is needed.
findings.issue: `schwarzReflection_eqOn_of_subset_im_nonneg`, `ContinuousOn.schwarzReflection_of_subset_im_nonneg`, and `DifferentiableOn.schwarzReflection_of_subset_im_nonneg` are thin public restatements of existing API: the already-present `schwarzReflection_of_im_nonneg` and Mathlib's `ContinuousOn.congr` / `DifferentiableOn.congr`.

summary: The added upper-branch transfer API is only unused public wrappers around the existing pointwise lemma plus Mathlib congruence lemmas, so this PR duplicates API rather than adding reusable new material.
